meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye ₹500 ke andar kai behtareen face washes milte hain jo excess oil ko control karte hain aur pores ko saaf rakhte hain. Aap apni skin ki zaroorat ke hisaab se inmein se koi bhi chun sakte hain:

Yeh face wash green tea aur glycolic acid ke sath aata hai jo **excess oil ko control karta hai** aur pores ko deep clean karta hai.

Isme **salicylic acid aur niacinamide** ka powerful combination hai jo breakouts ko rokhane aur acne marks ko fade karne mein madad karta hai.

Yeh cleanser ceramides aur niacinamide ke sath skin ka natural barrier banaye rakhte hue **gentle cleaning** deta hai.

Yeh 2% salicylic acid aur cica extract se bani hai jo **oil ko balance karti hai** aur skin ko bina dry kiye soothe karti hai.

Ek budget-friendly herbal option jo neem aur haldi ki khoobiyon ke sath **oil aur impurities ko hatakar** pimples ko control karta hai.

Yeh sulfate-free watermelon gel face wash skin ko **refreshing hydration** deta hai aur dullness door karta hai.

Yeh ek trusted formula hai jo pores mein deep jaakar **excess oil aur surface buildup** ko saaf karta hai.

Lemon aur honey ka yeh non-soap gel skin ko tight ya dry kiye bina **natural radiance aur oil-free feel** deta hai.
